text:
Maya Chen: heads up — planning release announce for Tuesday 10am PT. need final changelog, docs links, and a quick bench narrative we can put in the blog + slide for the webinar. who can own eng handoff?
Alex Rivera: I can take the changelog freeze — can we set freeze at Monday 5pm PT?
Jordan Patel: Monday 5pm works for eng. will push final PRs by then.
Samira Khan: marketing: we need a canonical docs link + /docs/changelog anchor. can eng ensure documentation is published by Monday EOD?
Alex Rivera: yes, will publish under https://docs.redwood.ai/release/1755 and push the changelog anchor.
Linh Tran: tagging the release-bot to schedule the rollout window once changelog is live. release-bot: please queue a canary at 10:00 with 2-hour watch window.
release-bot: queued canary for 2025-09-02T10:00:00-07:00, window 2h. notify: #eng-oncall, #eng-sre.
Maya Chen: perfect. also need a 2-paragraph bench narrative: one-line summary (latency/cost) + callouts for workload used. can Samira draft and eng sanity-check numbers?
Samira Khan: will draft. preliminary: "Redwood inference reduces 95th p99 latency by 18% at 2x throughput vs prior baseline; token cost down ~22% with prefix caching." can you confirm those numbers Alex?
Alex Rivera: numbers look close. final metric after last quant run: p99 down 16.8%, token cost down 21.3%. put rounding in marketing.
Jordan Patel: add note: measurements on g5.12x at seq_len=1024, batch=16, warm cache. mention fallback behavior for small requests.
Samira Khan: ok will include that detail in the blog. also need a CTA for webinar signups with UTM params for inbound routing. proposed CTA: "Sign up for the 9/4 deep-dive — seats limited" link: https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=announce&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=release1755
Maya Chen: inbound routing: please route signups to the Enterprise SDR queue if company size >50 or email ends with .edu/.gov -> special handling. Samira can you add hidden field on the form: "lead_tier" computed by JS?
Samira Khan: yes. will add param and pass to HubSpot. need a sample mapping from eng for user metadata: account_id, region, plan.
Alex Rivera: we can provide account_id & region in the API response logs; for form signup we'll supply region detection and plan inference flag. share field names: account_id, inferred_region, plan_hint.
Maya Chen: timeline check: Monday 5pm changelog freeze, Monday 11:59pm docs up, Tuesday 8am preflight email to beta list, Tuesday 10am public announce + blog + social + webinar modal.
Jordan Patel: rolling deploy plan: canary 10am (5% traffic), 11am 25%, 12pm full, rollback targets ready. I'll put the canary playbook in eng-releases.
Samira Khan: marketing assets needed: 1) blog draft 2) tweet copy 3) webinar slide 1 (bench visuals) 4) embedable signup modal html. I'll attach drafts in the doc once Alex confirms numbers.
Alex Rivera: confirmed. I pushed a short JSON payload sample for embedding in the blog: ```{ "version": "v1.755", "p99_reduction": "16.8%", "token_cost_reduction": "21.3%" }```
Maya Chen: small thing — changelog copy should avoid internal codenames. use feature-facing language. Samira will do friendly headlines.
Samira Khan: drafted headline options in google doc: "Faster, cheaper inference at scale" and "Reduce latency and cost with smarter serving." feedback?
Linh Tran: both good. prefers first for hero, second for subhead.
Jordan Patel: quick FYI for oncall: if errors spike >1.5x baseline during canary, auto-fallback to previous model version — config: `fallback_policy: auto_swap_on_error_rate`
Maya Chen: great. final asks: Alex — please drop final docs link here when live; Jordan — confirm canary playbook link; Samira — post blog + social drafts by Monday noon so we can review.
Alex Rivera: will post docs link: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/1755#changelog by Mon 23:30 PT.
Jordan Patel: canary playbook: https://redwood.ai/internal/eng-releases/canary-1755.md (shared with marketing).
Samira Khan: acknowledged — I'll aim for noon draft and will ping for signoff. :rocket:
Maya Chen: thanks all — looping back Monday morning for a final pulse. :thumbsup:
